# Explicit Author constraint: automated runs must be silent AND windowless

Force SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy and SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy; if visible/audible reproduction is needed, stop dependent work and have the Author launch it. Never inherit/use real PulseAudio/ALSA/etc under video-dummy. Please observe this during your runtime diagnosis as well.

The one audio test already finished normally before stop check; no process remains. It passed900frames/3600ticks with dummy video/real PulseAudio at28.33nominal FPS, independent state matches. This does not reproduce the actual-window startup failure and is not permission to repeat that test. Runner restored to forced silent dummy audio on Pi/Oryx; standing policy recorded in Rally AGENTS. No new launches since objection.

Black Author graphical run remains unresolved: exact passing prefix121112bytes stops416bytes into sign Source63800 WRITE of2048bytes at120688, while VDP scans4372frames/backend fault counters clear.
